newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin systems unit wins contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin systems unit wins contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp's Lockheed Martin Federal Systems said Tuesday it was awarded a contract valued at $21 million through the end of 1998 by the Minnesota Department of Transportation.
The total potential value of the contract is $30 million.
The company said the contract calls for it to create a system, which will be called Orion, linking city, county and state transportation agencies.
Information on the program will be used to reduce traffic congestion, improve emergency response times, and provide travelers with traffic information.
Information will be provided to commuters by telephone, fax, pager or electronic-mail.
